description: Create a draw that reveals at a future time, with the randomness round committed the instant you create it.

delay_sec.description: Seconds from now until the draw reveals. Must be a positive integer.

entrants.description: The entrant names. Duplicates are removed and the list is sorted before ranking.

title.description: A non-empty title for the draw.

winners.description: How many winners to pick. Defaults to 1; must be between 1 and the number of entrants.

name: create_scheduled_draw
